the scattering in 2 + 1 dimensions is universal in the sense that it is determined by the asymptotic form of the potential at infinity.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the scattering is universal for all potentials, even those which have a zero-energy resonance, as long as the resonance is not embedded in the continuum spectrum.
the low-energy scattering in two spatial dimensions is universal, and it does not depend on the specific potential.
